title: Governance Clarification: self-hosted-runner scope + ephemeral local exact-SHA CI exception

authority_basis.note: Substantive clarification captured verbatim from the founder (text + DCL digest above preserved exactly). status uses the exact repository ACTIVE convention; authority is governed structurally by authority_model below (protected-main only).

authority_model.status_meaning: status: "ACTIVE" expresses this record's protected-main governance classification. It does NOT grant authority to any non-authoritative copy. Authority is a function of LOCATION (refs/heads/main via the founder gate), not of the status string; there is no prefix/startsWith/prose interpretation.
authority_model.activation_event: The exact reviewed PR #185 head becomes authoritative only when founder-authorized and merged through Terminal-0 into refs/heads/main.

correction_provenance.v1_1_1_scope: status token corrected to the exact repository ACTIVE convention + structured authority_model (protected-main-only, prefix-parse ambiguity removed); the custom ACTIVE_IFF_* token is removed
correction_provenance.substantive_clarification_unchanged: the self-hosted-runner prohibition scope (5), the 17 ephemeral-local-CI controls, the does_not list (10), and does_not_supersede are UNCHANGED from v1.0.0

self_hosted_runner_prohibition_applies_t: reusable agents waiting for externally dispatched CI work
externally triggered execution on founder-controlled hardware without a separate founder-controlled gate

ephemeral_local_ci_exception.description: The self-hosted-runner prohibition does NOT apply to ephemeral founder-controlled local exact-SHA verification when ALL of the following controls are satisfied.
controls_all_required: execution is manually initiated through Terminal-0
no runner is registered with GitHub Actions
no persistent background runner or service exists
no externally dispatched job intake is accepted
the source is acquired from a mechanically verified exact commit SHA
Mac and Docker verification layers use the same canonical source archive and fingerprint
Mac source directories and workspaces are disposable
Docker networking is disabled unless separately authorized and proven necessary
no home directory, secrets, credentials, Docker socket, production data, or customer data are exposed
all affected tests are classified in a machine-readable manifest
mechanically justified host-dependent tests execute on the authorized Mac
test results and evidence identifiers are sealed in reproducible evidence packets
one independent checker and one separate read-only Advisor review the exact head and evidence
Terminal-0 remains the sole merge sheriff
every pull request receives its own founder merge gate
ephemeral_local_ci_exception.effect_when_all_controls_satisfied: qualifying ephemeral local exact-SHA verification MAY satisfy the `exact_sha_ci_green` evidence predicate

does_not: make Hybrid Local Exact-SHA CI the default provider
authorize GitHub billing or spending changes
authorize a registered or persistent self-hosted runner
activation_requirements_all_required: reviewed by a separate read-only Advisor
approved through a separate founder governance merge gate
activation_completion: The founder-authorized Terminal-0 merge of the exact reviewed PR #185 head into protected main is the FINAL and COMPLETING activation requirement. Upon that merge, every item in activation_requirements_all_required is satisfied and this record is authoritative per authority_model (authoritative_ref refs/heads/main). No later status flip or follow-up activation mutation is required or authorized.
does_not_supersede: All other ARLC merge-readiness predicates (exact_sha_ci_green is necessary, never sufficient)
